Check loading approval and delivery acknowledgements alongside both journey records when reconciling a split dispatch.

Review completed collections against supplier handovers and the revised route at the end of the shift.

Use technician completion notes with both trip histories before closing the unresolved service job.

Compare stationary periods with rest and customer records before classifying them as delivery exceptions.
